messages:
ravi: FYI I noticed a weird divergence on the latency page after we flipped the new routing weights. p99 looks a hair better but p50/p95 increased. Dashboard only shows merged percentiles so it's confusing. anyone dug into route splits?

emma: I pulled samples: main-route p95=190ms p99=910ms, fallback p95=340ms p99=430ms. merged tdigest p95=230ms merged exact (sampled) p95=205ms. Looks like tdigest merge is exaggerating the merged p95.

janet (console): UX problem: PMs read endpoint p95 and assume single distribution. we should add an inline "routes" count (e.g., routes:3) and make hover show per-route p50/p95/p99 + counts. Also add an "approx" badge when using tdigest.

kai: Agreed on UI. On the infra side: tdigest centroids merge poorly when mass shifts between modes. We should detect multimodality and either compute exact quantiles for that endpoint on request or surface a warning.

ravi: Detection idea: compute a quick dip test or 2-component GMM separation score on a 15m window; emit a bimodal_flag true/false. If true, console auto-opens per-route breakdown and adds a yellow banner: "Mixed latency modes detected ".

metrics-bot: Job 120999 submitted by emma: per-route quantiles + diptest (/v1/generate) over 15m. ETA ~20s.

emma: results: main-route cnt=52,300 p50=70 p95=190 p99=920; fallback cnt=6,140 p50=130 p95=340 p99=430; diptest=0.37 -> bimodal. fallback_fraction ~10%.

sre-oncall: For autoscaling we care about tail mass on the main route. If fallback_fraction grows, our scaling thresholds may be triggered incorrectly. Need raw counts per route each 5m for the last hour.

janet (console): UX spec draft: (1) add routes badge on sparkline; (2) hover expands to per-route percentiles and sample counts; (3) show an "approx" pill when using tdigest and offer a "compute exact" button (costly); (4) auto-show per-route view when bimodal_flag=true or fallback_fraction>5%. I'll attach mockups in the ticket.

kai: Implementation notes: prefer_exact_quantiles API param is fine; warn about 3-5x cost. Also consider a hybrid aggregator: lightweight fixed-bucket histogram per-endpoint that gives stable quantiles for multimodal loads without fetching raw samples.

emma: I'll prototype the diptest job and a sampling job that computes an exact quantile for endpoints flagged bimodal. We can keep merged tdigest for the cheap view and only compute exact when users click "compute exact" or when the endpoint is under a rollout.

ravi: Rollout process change: default comparator should be per-route p95 (or show merged+per-route) so PMs don't approve regressions hidden by merged p99. Add to rollout runbook: "If bimodal_flag OR fallback_fraction>3% compare per-route p50/p95 before approving."

sre-oncall: I'll add a dashboard for route counts over time and a small alert: if fallback_fraction spikes >8% within 10m, page oncall. That should catch bad weight configs.

metrics-bot: Job 120999 completed in 18s. Results uploaded to ENG-6211.

janet (console): tiny UX quibble: when we show per-route percentiles inline, include a tiny legend for route colors and show counts next to percentiles ("p95 340ms (6.1k)"). PMs love seeing counts.

kai: Longer-term: experiment with local histogram aggregator + reservoir sampling fallback for heavy endpoints. That will make quantiles more robust and lower cost than exact queries.

emma: Action items: emma -> add diptest job + exact-on-demand job; janet -> spec + mockups + ticket; kai -> prototype histogram aggregator; ravi -> update rollout runbook; sre-oncall -> add fallback_fraction alert + counts dashboard.

ravi: Thanks. One quick short-term: janet, can you add the "approx" label to the current dashboard this week? It's low-risk and will reduce misreads.

janet (console): Yep will ship a small tooltip + approx pill by EOD Friday.

ravi: Great, tagging @product and @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
